comparison.objective: Candidate mechanically calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-996 calibrates a colorimeter with a blank and measures a sealed sample at a requested wavelength.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires physical screw/nut countertorque and mechanism actuation; PR-996 requires cuvette identification, optical-face alignment, device-button operation and ordered reference measurement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires angle retention through repeated cycles; PR-996 requires a valid blank reference, accurate sample reading, and both cuvettes returned released and still.
comparison.reason: The word calibration describes different tested abilities: optical reference workflow versus force-coupled mechanical adjustment; all material rubric details are present.
